evidence.reason: Added a durable_directory() helper to apps/crq-python/review_ledger.py that creates a directory tree and fsyncs each newly created directory's entry in its parent, and applied it in atomic() (first-use pending/, ack/ and sha256/ creation behind spool(), put() and acknowledge()), locked() (spool's outbox root) and ArtifactStore.put_file(), so a crash can no longer lose a newly created directory and its accepted evidence after a reported success; local Python tests were not runnable under the harness's git-only command allowlist, so CI remains the test authority.
